name: English - English for Scientific Purposes C1
description: In this course, each week articles to be read and videos to be watched are assigned.  In the following week, there are active small group discussions about the articles and videos assigned.  In addition, each week some elements of English grammar are reviewed.  Finally, there are also written assignments that must be completed.
prerequisites: Upper B2 or C1 level according to the online placement test at www.moodle.tum.de.
